intended_object: A hard-coded lookup table, one hash-bucket group of precomputed "monotone-obstruction" pattern summaries (pairs of natural-number codes). It is used as certificate data in a computer-checked case analysis for the Erdős #97 convex-octagon problem. I inferred this from the docstring, the file name (CoverageSummaryData25) and the namespace (RawIncidence).
explanation: The definition is a literal `Array (List PatternSummary)` of encoded numbers grouped into hash buckets. It is generated certificate data for a computational proof and an implementation detail of that proof. It does not formalize any mathematical object from the literature, so there is nothing to compare it against and no general notion for it to be narrower than.
